text:
maria: Heads up — starting tenant_profiles migration in the 02:00 UTC change window. Canary on shard-a first, then staggered waves. Pin app svc to v2.14.1 for the window. ETA ~40m per wave. Ack?
kevin: ack. what kind of locks/backfill are we expecting?
maria: online backfill (batched UPDATEs), we should only see brief row-level locks. No global DDL. If we hit long lock waits we abort wave.
kevin: ok. can you paste the deploybot run command you will use?
maria: `deploybot run migrate --job tenant_profiles --shard shard-a --wave 1 --rate 200`
raj: add rollback criteria here: abort if p95 latency up >2% for >5m or error-rate >5% sustained, or if lock_wait >5s on master for >30s. Also mark canary as failed if >10% of rows report conflict errors.
taylor: +1 to raj. also add an automated traffic split to 90/10 during canary so we can measure impact.
deploybot: [automated] run queued: id=run-3333, owner=maria, job=tenant_profiles, shard=shard-a. Preflight checks: schema-compat OK, feature-flag tenant_profiles_shadow ON.
ops-bot: :warning: note: region-us-west has a scheduled infra maintenance 03:15 UTC but it shouldn't touch DB. Recommend we avoid starting wave 3 after 03:00 to be safe.
maria: good catch, we'll schedule wave 3 earlier or delay if needed.
kevin: if we need a fast rollback, what's the escape hatch?
maria: escape hatch plan: 1) deploybot abort-run run-3333 2) pin app to v2.14.0 and disable backfill feature-flag 3) open support notification and run a quick reindex if needed. I've tested abort-run in staging.
raj: record that in release notes and ops playbook. Also add an explicit holdpoint after canary for 10m to validate metrics.
taylor: I'll add the holdpoint to the deploy config: `--hold-after canary --hold-duration 10m`
deploybot: [automated] canary wave started on shard-a. tracking metrics: latency, error-rate, lock-waits. streaming logs -> https://logs.example.com/run-3333
maria: monitoring: watch p95, db.lock.waits, and error-rate. If anything crosses thresholds we abort. Ping here when canary completes. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: reminder: support rotation on-call is jen@support for the 02:00 window. Loop them in if we trigger rollback.
kevin: noted. I'll be by my laptop.
maria: canary passed basic checks at +8m, holdpoint engaged. Proceeding to wave 2 in 5m unless objections.
raj: no objections. proceed but keep the rollback steps handy.
aylor: (typo) taylor: proceeding.
maria: wave 2 started.
deploybot: [automated] wave 2 running. progress: 12% complete.
kevin: seeing a small spike in lock_waits on replica but not on primary yet. watching.
kevin: spike subsided, looks transient.
maria: advancing. If we see repeated lock_wait spikes we'll abort and revert feature-flag.
kevin: noted.
maria: wave 2 complete. no regression signals. planning wave 3 before 03:00 to avoid maintenance.
ops-bot: :white_check_mark: all good. tagging this thread for the release notes and post-run cleanup (drop shadow table after 24h if no issues).
maria: thanks all — will post final status in 30m and update the release notes with the run id and rollback criteria.
